physics_capture_meta.source_visual_scope: Actual current USD visual points,fullrelative transforms; not cooked PhysX readback
physics_capture_meta.commanded_bottom_definition: min Z of allactualderivedsourcevisualvertices transformed by currentmeasuredcup-in-hand relation and LulaFK(command_q7) handpose; hypotheticalinstantaneousrigidfollowing,notactualdescent andnotattachment
physics_capture_meta.contact_force_unit: N: every tensor contact API explicitly called with physics_dt; raw impulse separately Ns
physics_capture_meta.gripper_target_semantics: symmetric per-finger joint target_m; total opening=2*target; raw action envelope retains totalopening

velocity_channels.usd_linear: UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.GetVelocityAttr,world axes,stage-length/s; may be stale under Fabric
velocity_channels.usd_angular: UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.GetAngularVelocityAttr,world axes,deg/s; may be stale under Fabric

physics_capture_meta.timestamp_semantics: capture after completed physics step; initialrow0 FD unknown,allAPI reads same no-step interval
physics_capture_meta.bottom_partition: selectedseat point within±50um ofdeclaredfloorsurface andupwardforce cosine>=0.5; no whole-seatFz substitute
physics_capture_meta.bottom_partition_limitations: Contactpoint is solver report,not materialintersectionproof; sloped/unidentifiedsupport remains wall/unknown

material_geometry.scope: Current source visual vessel material versus unchanged selected-seat collision input triangles; NOT cooked PhysX readback
material_geometry.query_units: mm; returned length fields use m
material_geometry.method: Exact closest point on triangles for every vertex and at most256 deterministic stratified face-centroids per mesh; both mesh directions; complete unique-edge finite segment-triangle crossing queries
limitations: Finite surface samples can miss a maximum penetration between samples; reported depth is an observed value, not a global upper bound.
Segment crossing detects transverse triangle crossings, not every coplanar overlap; coplanar contact is additionally sampled by point-to-triangle distance.
Original seat input mesh has open boundary edges. Its signed-distance side classification uses local face orientation/ray parity and is qualified near open boundaries.
No access to effective cooked PhysX shapes or solver material deformation; no claim to exclude all cooked-shape penetration.

contacts.force_fusion: audit only; callback impulse/force never summed with tensor normal/friction channels
